title: I’m a plumber in mall world and I don’t like it

classification.question_topic: Asking if others have unpleasant/only-work jobs in Mall World dreams

meta.occupation_in_dream: plumber (also mentions being a sprinkler fitter in waking life)
meta.author_theory: Thinks they might be responsible for repairing damaging effects of other people’s dreams on the world.

qualities.raw_description: "A GIGANTIC bathroom"; "Two rows of walls ran down through the central area, about twenty five feet across each, with a row of stalls on each side of both"; "The exterior wall was lined with urinals, a rectangle about 50x25 feet in total"; "There’s a wall of sinks visible from the doorway"; "the actual bathroom can be entered through openings at each end of the walls"; "It was destroyed. Like a group came through with sledgehammers"; "Not a single toilet was intact"; "every single opening was spraying"; "the flood as it overflowed like a waterfall into that central area"; "I don’t know how many floors up we were but it felt high"

interactions.description: Repair work in the destroyed bathroom during the night: loading shards of porcelain into a gondola, setting toilets, soldering piping, mounting urinals, installing pedestal sinks; turning water off / addressing spraying openings while janitors fight flooding.

entities_involved.description: janitors with yellow blockade things set up on either side struggling to fight the flood

extraction.extraction_notes: Single detailed dream location (giant public bathroom) plus general statement that dreams are recurring and work-focused; lighting/privacy not described explicitly.
